answers.genPolicy:d507be68d6f16df25958d04ddcf5c8:
[B1] < Cloud | Device : ('trusted' : (UserX, Rest), 'key' : Key, ...) , ... > $ UserX 'requestKey' Cloud
=> < Cloud | Device : ('trusted' : (UserX, Rest), 'key' : Key, ...) , ... > $ Cloud 'sendKey' UserX | (Key) .
[B1] < UserX | 'key' : nils , ... > $ Cloud 'sendKey' UserX | (Key)
=> < UserX | 'key' : Key, ... > .
[B2] < Cloud | Device : ('trusted' : (UserX, Rest), ...) , ... > $ UserX 'delegateAccess' Cloud | (Device ; UserY)
=> < Cloud | Device : ('trusted' : (UserX, UserY, Rest), ...) , ... > .
[B3] < Cloud | Device : ('trusted' : (UserX, UserY, Rest), ...) , ... > $ UserX 'revokeAccess' Cloud | (Device ; UserY)
=> < Cloud | Device : ('trusted' : (UserX, Rest), ...) , ... > .
[B4] < UserX | 'key' : Key, ... > < cloudSmartThing | deviceSwitch : ('key' : Key, 'status' : 'off', ...) , ... > $ UserX 'turnOn' cloudSmartThing | (deviceSwitch ; Key)
=> < UserX | 'key' : Key, ... > < cloudSmartThing | deviceSwitch : ('key' : Key, 'status' : 'on', ...) , ... > $ cloudSmartThing 'turnOn' deviceSwitch .
[B5] < deviceSwitch | ... > $ UserX 'turnOn' deviceSwitch
=> < deviceSwitch | ... > .
[B6] < Cloud | Device : ('trusted' : (P, Rest), 'status' : 'off', ...) , ... > $ P 'turnOn' Device
=> < Cloud | Device : ('trusted' : (P, Rest), 'status' : 'on', ...) , ... > $ Cloud 'turnOn' Device .
[B7] < cloudSmartThing | deviceSwitch : ('linkedLock' : deviceLock, ...) , ... > $ cloudSmartThing 'turnOn' deviceSwitch
=> < cloudSmartThing | deviceSwitch : ('linkedLock' : deviceLock, ...) , ... > $ cloudSmartThing 'turnOn' deviceLock .
[B8] < deviceLock | 'trusted' : (P, Rest), 'status' : 'off', ... > $ P 'turnOn' deviceLock
=> < deviceLock | 'trusted' : (P, Rest), 'status' : 'on', ... > .
